rules.statement: The liquid assets of the estate should be utilized for the payment of testamentary expenses, debts, funeral expenses and estate duty before being distributed among heirs as on intestacy.
rules.supporting_quote: "If of course there was a residue of undevised liquid assets which remained after payment of all the liabilities of the estate, the general principle that it would devolve on the heirs as on intestacy would be unexceptionable. But when there were outstanding debts and other liabilities of the estate to be met, it would in our opinion be wrong to distribute such residue among the heirs as on intestacy so that the entire estate will be chargeable with debts and other liabilities."
